title: Super status, working from home, runway drama: Catch up on the day’s stories | CNN
text:
👋Welcome to 5 Things PM!A lot of people love the flexibility of working from home, but new research suggests it could betaking a toll on your mental health.

Here’s what else you might have missed during your busy day.

An already-strong El Niño has been ramping up at a breakneck pace since it was first declared in June, and the climate phenomenon is crossing into unprecedented territory. Experts explainwhat that means for the weather.

⛅ Get your local forecast:Download the CNN Weather app

Thanks to a geographic quirk, Louis Patenaude’s freight business straddles the border between the US and Canada. With the once close allies embroiled in a heated trade war, he finds himselfcaught in the middle.

The head of American fashion’s leading trade associationapologized for reacting “inappropriately”after an altercation with animal rights protesters during a New York show.

➕ Bob Mackie:Designer who made stars sparkle dies at 87

Did you know that dark matter makes up about 85% of all the matter in the universe? Scientists say they’vedetected an intriguing signalthat could shed some light on the elusive substance.

Traumatized doctors on “The Pitt.” Conflicted city officials on “Widow’s Bay.” Struggling teachers on “Abbott Elementary.” This year’s Emmy Awards are about regular people trying to keep their heads above water.Follow live updates.

👠Watch now:CNN and Variety are streaming from the red carpetwith an All Access subscription.

🥬 Drugs on the DL:More than 2,000 pounds of meth was foundhidden in a shipment of cabbagein Texas, authorities said. The seizure was part of a multi-agency investigation in the Rio Grande Valley.

👩‍🎨 A vision in blue:A new sculpture in London’s Trafalgar Square, by New York-based artist Tschabalala Self, represents the contemporary everywoman. She’s strong, andshe’s going places.

EDITOR’S NOTE:Interested in exclusive stories like these?Choose a plan

🏈This week, Lane Kiffin’s LSU Tigers will face which school he coached last season?

A. USC

B. Georgia

C. Tennessee

D. Ole Miss

⬇️Scroll down for the answer.

✅Most popular in Friday’s newsletter:Scientists look inside the ‘spider’ growing on the tip of a rare viper’s tail

🧠Quiz answer: D.Kiffin’s bitter split with Ole Missreopened old wounds, and he returns to Oxford as Public Enemy No. 1.

👋 We’ll see you tomorrow.

Today’s edition of 5 Things PM was edited and produced by CNN’s Kimberly Richardson and Gina Park.
